one_sentence_description: AI re-entry cards restore context after interruptions and point to the next tiny step
current_tools_fail_because: Planners store tasks but not live mental context or restart cues
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: It solves the exact 'what was I doing again?' problem without requiring more planning
why_it_could_win: Clear before-and-after story, accessibility framing, and credible AI use

one_sentence_description: Turns 'I cannot start' into one tiny action, a timer, and optional accountability
current_tools_fail_because: Many apps decompose tasks but do not ignite action in the moment
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Fast relief from paralysis is highly relatable and phone-friendly
why_it_could_win: Very buildable and useful, with a simple story judges understand instantly

one_sentence_description: A wearable or desk button captures current task state and later pings a resume cue
problem_solved: Interruption recovery with stronger physical cues
current_tools_fail_because: Phone prompts are easy to ignore and most tools do not create a physical anchor
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: A tactile cue can cut through notification blindness and feel genuinely assistive
why_it_could_win: Hardware plus accessibility creates memorable demo theater

one_sentence_description: Preserves research or work context in the browser as resumable bundles
current_tools_fail_because: Browsers show tabs, not intent or task state
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Useful for students and knowledge workers with tab chaos
why_it_could_win: Clean student demo with visible transformation

one_sentence_description: A shame-safe daily reset flow helps users restart after a derailed day
current_tools_fail_because: Most systems punish misses or simply keep piling tasks up
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: It acknowledges the emotional crash and helps momentum return
why_it_could_win: Human, empathetic, and highly relatable for judges

one_sentence_description: When users fall behind, it shows what to do now, defer, or drop
current_tools_fail_because: Most tools assume a clean slate instead of failure recovery
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Students and professionals both feel this pain sharply
why_it_could_win: High judge relatability and a simple narrative

one_sentence_description: Voice plus context tags help future self restart later from a phone-first flow
current_tools_fail_because: Voice memos are too messy to act on later
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Phone-native and emotionally intuitive
why_it_could_win: Good fallback if only mobile is available

one_sentence_description: One tap launches AI or human body-doubling support when stuck
current_tools_fail_because: Current body-doubling tools require scheduling and social effort
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Combines accountability with low-friction rescue
why_it_could_win: Good social demo and obvious usefulness

one_sentence_description: A short emotional check-in reframes the setback and turns it into the next action
current_tools_fail_because: Emotion support and task support are usually separated
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Validates the user without becoming a therapy app
why_it_could_win: Strong emotional resonance for judges

one_sentence_description: Reminders escalate across modalities until the user actually re-engages
current_tools_fail_because: Static reminders are easy to ignore or miss
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Targets a common and concrete complaint
why_it_could_win: Easy to understand and visually demo

one_sentence_description: Shared executive-function dashboard for partners or caregivers
problem_solved: Unequal invisible labor and missed follow-through
current_tools_fail_because: Most ADHD tools are single-user and ignore household coordination
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Emotionally powerful for real life
why_it_could_win: Strong story but heavier scope

one_sentence_description: A live map of active open loops across docs, tasks, and email
current_tools_fail_because: Systems are fragmented and hard to reconstitute
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Feels like a working-memory prosthetic
why_it_could_win: Visually impressive if pulled off

one_sentence_description: Turns course docs and assignment prompts into next-step cards
current_tools_fail_because: Syllabus and LMS information stays inert
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: High student relevance and very hackathon-friendly
why_it_could_win: Good academic demo but less unique

one_sentence_description: Cuts through small daily decisions when depleted
current_tools_fail_because: Most productivity tools add choices instead of removing them
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Helpful when cognitive energy is low
why_it_could_win: Simple and friendly but less wow

one_sentence_description: Calendar events automatically trigger focus mode and app blocking
problem_solved: Failure to transition into work when it is time to start
current_tools_fail_because: Calendars do not protect execution
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Very practical for work and study blocks
why_it_could_win: Nice functionality demo but not very novel

one_sentence_description: Summarizes missed messages and drafts gentle restart replies
current_tools_fail_because: Messaging tools do not reduce re-entry friction
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Emotionally relatable, especially after ghosting or overload
why_it_could_win: Broad appeal but weaker ADHD specificity

one_sentence_description: Location-aware prompts tied to routines and objects
problem_solved: Remembering tasks at the right place and time
current_tools_fail_because: Regular reminders arrive at the wrong time
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Useful for errands and life admin
why_it_could_win: Tangible mobile demo but less novel

one_sentence_description: AI errand sequencer that reduces spatial/context-switching friction
current_tools_fail_because: Task apps ignore travel and switching cost
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Practical and easy to grasp
why_it_could_win: Less emotionally powerful than top concepts

one_sentence_description: Context-aware self-care pet tied to actual task friction
current_tools_fail_because: Gamified tools are often detached from real work friction
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Friendly and sticky if executed well
why_it_could_win: Could be charming, but risks looking shallow

one_sentence_description: A floating scratchpad keeps current intent visible across apps
current_tools_fail_because: Notes and tabs do not keep the current intention salient
why_compelling_for_adhd_users: Feels assistive and practical
why_it_could_win: Good accessibility framing but less punchy demo
